mapper.sql: gld.chart_account_id IN ( SELECT id FROM chart_accounts WHERE is_active = 1 AND chart_account_type_id IN ( SELECT id FROM chart_account_types WHERE name = 'Accounts Receivable' ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN gld.debit > 0 AND gl.credit_memo_receipt_id IS NULL THEN gld.debit ELSE 0 END ) + SUM( CASE WHEN gld.debit > 0 AND gl.credit_memo_id IN ( SELECT credit_memo_id FROM general_ledgers WHERE is_active = 1 AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND date = #{filter.dateTo} AND credit > 0 AND sales_order_id IS NULL AND main_gl_id IS NULL ) THEN gld.debit ELSE 0 END ) - SUM( CASE WHEN gld.credit > 0 AND ( gl.sales_order_id IN ( SELECT sales_order_id FROM general_ledgers WHERE is_active = 1 AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND date = #{filter.dateTo} AND debit > 0 AND credit_memo_receipt_id IS NULL ) OR gld.main_gl_id IN ( SELECT id FROM general_ledgers WHERE is_active = 1 AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND date = #{filter.dateTo} AND debit > 0 AND credit_memo_receipt_id IS NULL ) ) THEN gld.credit ELSE 0 END ) - SUM( CASE WHEN gld.credit > 0 AND gl.sales_order_id IS NULL AND gld.main_gl_id IS NULL THEN gld.credit ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS amount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id = gld.general_ledger_id WHERE gl.is_active = 1 AND AND gld.customer_id = #{customerId} AND gl.date = #{filter.dateTo}
